newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Senate confidence votes set for Monday.
newsitem.headline: Italy Senate confidence votes set for Monday.

text.p: Italy's Senate will vote on Monday on three confidence votes called by the centre-left government on Friday to sweep aside some 3,000 blocking amendments to its 1997 budget, parliamentary officials said.

They said four hours had been set aside for the confidence debate on Saturday morning. It will resume on Monday morning and the first of the three votes was scheduled to begin at 1530 GMT on Monday, the officials said.
Prime Minister Romano Prodi's government has a comfortable majority in the Senate and is not at risk of defeat.
